confirmed: The frozen proposed Isp HOLD -> Pac RESCUE -> both exits ordering, both necessary roles, modest headroom transfer and safe continuous-floor hazard estimate are confirmed by source and finite completion.
missed_mechanics: RESCUE is a latch opening both gates, so Pac need not keep holding it after activation. Its attack interruption clears a current projectile once; it does not disable Gem permanently.
incorrect_inferences: No definite incorrect first-pass mechanic was asserted: movements were conditional. The suggestion that Pac might need to maintain the middle-pad condition is unnecessary once the rescue latch activates.
